projects.title: Job Sourcing
projects.description: Developed and deployed a microservices-based recruitment platform with integrated AI features, enabling efficient candidate-job matching, streamlined hiring processes, and low-latency performance.

projects.title: QBDEX
projects.description: Built a pharmaceutical Quality by Design (QbD) application, enabling streamlined experimental planning, process optimization, and enhanced regulatory compliance.

projects.title: Paperclip
projects.description: Node.js/React platform orchestrating a team of AI development agents (Manager, PO, Frontend Developer, Backend Developer) to run software projects end-to-end. Each agent is assigned per-project skills, permissions, and MCP tool access. Manager/PO agents split incoming tasks, synchronize work across dev agents, and push code and open pull requests directly on GitHub via MCP integration, all tracked from a single dashboard.

projects.title: Zenger
projects.description: Full-stack journalism platform powering editorial workflow end-to-end: pitch intake, rich story editing with style checking, media attachments, and channel-based outlet distribution. Includes NewsFindr, an A2A-protocol AI agent orchestrator (Google ADK + Gemini) coordinating specialized sub-agents to detect news events and produce structured flash stories autonomously.

personalProjects.title: Tic Tac Toe AI (AlphaGo)
personalProjects.description: Implemented a Reinforcement Learning AI agent using the AlphaGo algorithm. The agent learns from self-play to master the game of Tic Tac Toe, simulating human-like moves and adapting strategies.

personalProjects.title: Deep Fake Detection
personalProjects.description: Developed a Deep Fake detection system using LSTM-based Artificial Neural Networks. Detects manipulated media content to combat misinformation and ensure digital content authenticity.

personalProjects.title: ANN from Scratch (Cat vs Dog)
personalProjects.description: Built an Artificial Neural Network from scratch using only NumPy. Implements forward and backward propagation to classify images of cats and dogs without relying on high-level ML frameworks.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer | Cloud Engineer | AI
details: Designed and developed web applications using Spring Boot, Node.js, Express.js, and Next.js, optimized for high performance and low latency.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines on Google Cloud to automate build, testing, and deployment, reducing manual errors and accelerating releases.
Deployed applications on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) using GitHub Actions, improving deployment reliability and reproducibility.
Designed scalable cloud architectures on GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage) ensuring high availability and automatic scaling.

Designed and implemented an AI agent orchestration system using an A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol, where a primary agent dynamically coordinates specialized sub-agents to detect breaking news events and generate flash stories in real time.

Championed the shift toward AI-augmented, agentic development, onboarding the team onto AI coding tools and agent-driven workflows that boosted engineering efficiency and cut feature build time by ~3x.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer | AWS DevOps Engineer
details: Designed and developed multiple enterprise-level microservice applications using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Angular, and Docker, with Keycloak authentication securing sensitive data for 10,000+ active users. Improved system efficiency by 11% and reduced response time by 20% across critical modules.

Built robust microservices communication using REST APIs for synchronous calls and Kafka/AWS SQS for asynchronous messaging across 15+ distributed microservices, improving data throughput by 35%, reducing inter-service latency by 25%, and enabling seamless horizontal scalability.
Integrated AI-powered features with Large Language Models (LLMs) into large-scale microservices, automating processing of tens of thousands of records per month, improving workflow efficiency by 40%.

Implemented and optimized CI/CD pipelines for a 5-developer team, reducing deployment time from hours to under 1 hour (75% faster), doubling release frequency, and enabling continuous delivery across 15+ microservices in production.
Delivered robust infrastructure solutions leveraging serverless and compute services (ECS, EKS, EC2), supporting automatic scaling and ensuring 99.9% uptime under peak loads.
Enhanced cloud security, reducing unauthorized access incidents by 90%.
Engineered an event-driven architecture to enable asynchronous communication, improve scalability, and decouple services.

experience.title: Freelance Cloud & AI Consultant
details: Acted as an independent AWS consultant for early-stage startups, monitoring and reviewing existing cloud architectures to catch scalability, cost, and security risks early, giving founders a fractional cloud architect without a full-time hire.
Advised multiple startup clients on infrastructure decisions, helping them avoid costly rework and over-provisioning as they scaled.
Built and customized a multi-agent AI development platform (see Projects — Paperclip) for startup clients, tailoring agent roles, skills, and permissions to each team's workflow.
Cut AI/LLM hallucinations by ~20% and reduced token/API cost by tightening the context and scope given to each agent, making AI-assisted development materially cheaper and more reliable for clients.
Sped up feature delivery by ~30% for client engineering teams by automating task breakdown, implementation, and PR creation across coordinated dev agents.
